Name: Market Square
Address: 655 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Market Square is the heart of downtown Lake Forest and one of the first planned shopping centers in the United States. Its charming architecture, local boutiques, and cafés make it feel both historic and lively. It’s the kind of place that makes the town feel connected and community-driven.

Name: Lake Forest Beach
Address: 1110 N Lake Shore Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Lake Forest Beach offers stunning views of Lake Michigan and is a peaceful place to unwind. The walking paths, sailboats, and open shoreline make it feel calm and expansive. It’s especially beautiful at sunset and feels like a hidden escape within the suburbs.

Name: Elawa Farm
Address: 1401 Middlefork Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Elawa Farm blends history, sustainability, and community all in one space. Originally built in the early 1900s, it now hosts local markets, educational programs, and seasonal events. It’s a meaningful spot because it connects Lake Forest’s past with a focus on local food and community engagement.

Name: Lake Forest College
Address: 555 N Sheridan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Lake Forest College is a small liberal arts college with a beautiful lakeside campus. The tree-lined paths and historic buildings give it a classic collegiate feel. It plays an important role in the town’s culture and brings energy, diversity, and academic life to the community.

Name: Dickinson Hall
Address: 100 E Old Mill Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Dickinson Hall is a community center that serves as a gathering place for elderly residents. It hosts events, fitness programs, and social activities that strengthen local connections. It represents the town’s commitment to community involvement and active living.

Name: Crab Tree Farm
Address: 3 Eastwoods Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Crab Tree Farm preserves historic architecture and traditional craftsmanship in a peaceful, pastoral setting. Visitors can explore restored barns, gardens, and exhibitions focused on early 20th-century design. It feels quiet and intentional, offering a slower pace that highlights artistry and heritage.

Name: Deer Path Inn
Address: 255 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Deer Path Inn feels like stepping into an English countryside estate right in the middle of Lake Forest. The elegant dining rooms, afternoon tea service, and cozy fireplaces make it perfect for special occasions. It blends historic charm with a refined, welcoming atmosphere.

Name: Starbucks (Market Square)
Address: 724 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Located in Market Square, this Starbucks is a central meeting spot for students, families, and professionals. It’s always buzzing with energy, especially after school or on weekend mornings. It feels like a small-town hub inside a national brand.

Name: Hansa Coffee Roasters
Address: 24 E Scranton Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: Just minutes from Lake Forest, Hansa Coffee offers a cozy, community-focused atmosphere. The locally roasted coffee and warm interior make it feel personal and welcoming. It’s a quieter alternative for studying or catching up with friends.

Name: West Park
Address: 1525 N Waukegan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: West Park is one of the largest recreational spaces in Lake Forest, featuring sports fields, tennis courts, and open green space. It’s a major gathering place for youth sports and community events. The energy here reflects the town’s active lifestyle.

Name: Middlefork Savanna Forest Preserve
Address: 1401 Middlefork Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Middlefork Savanna offers wide open prairie landscapes and scenic walking trails. It’s peaceful and expansive, especially in the fall when the grasses change color. It feels like a natural retreat just outside the residential neighborhoods.

Name: Lake Forest High School
Address: 1285 N McKinley Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Lake Forest High School is known for its strong academics, athletics, and community involvement. The campus feels modern and well-supported, reflecting the town’s investment in education. Friday night football games and school events bring the community together.

Name: Lake Bluff Middle School
Address: 31 E Sheridan Pl, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: Serving students from the Lake Forest and Lake Bluff area, this middle school emphasizes both academic growth and extracurricular involvement. It’s a formative place for many local families. The strong sense of community carries into high school and beyond.

Name: Gorton Community Center
Address: 400 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Gorton Center is a nonprofit cultural hub that hosts films, performances, classes, and community events. It’s a place where creativity and local engagement come together. The building itself has historic character while supporting modern programming.

Name: Onwentsia Club
Address: 300 N Green Bay Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Onwentsia Club is one of the most historic private golf clubs in the Midwest. The beautifully maintained grounds and traditional clubhouse reflect Lake Forest’s long-standing traditions. It represents a more classic and exclusive side of the community.

Name: Lake Forest Open Lands Association
Address: 350 N Waukegan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: This organization preserves miles of scenic trails and open prairie land throughout Lake Forest. The quiet paths feel untouched and peaceful, offering a break from busy routines. It represents the town’s deep commitment to conservation.

Name: Fort Sheridan Forest Preserve
Address: 1280 Gilgare Ln, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Fort Sheridan blends history with sweeping lake views and dramatic ravines. Former military buildings now sit alongside hiking trails and open shoreline. It feels both historic and expansive at the same time.

Name: Lake Forest Library
Address: 360 E Deerpath Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The Lake Forest Library is more than just books — it’s a quiet community anchor. With study spaces, events, and historic architecture, it feels calm and intentional. It’s a meaningful place for learning and reflection.

Name: Forest Park Beach
Address: 1050 N Lake Shore Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Forest Park Beach is known for its dramatic bluff views and quiet shoreline. The walking path above the lake offers one of the most scenic views in town. It’s peaceful and feels slightly tucked away.

Name: Mellody Farm Nature Preserve
Address: 350 N Waukegan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Mellody Farm Preserve features rolling meadows and walking trails just outside downtown. It’s especially beautiful in the fall and spring. It feels open, simple, and grounding.

Name: Woodlands Academy of The Sacred Heart
Address: 625 N Sheridan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Woodlands Academy of the Sacred Heart is a private, Roman Catholic girls' high school in the northeast side of Lake Forest. Founded by the Society of the Sacred Heart, it is located in the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Chicago.

Name: Lake Forest Cemetery
Address: 1525 N Sheridan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Overlooking Lake Michigan, this cemetery is surprisingly scenic and peaceful. The bluff views and historic monuments give it a reflective, almost park-like feel. It connects the town to generations of history.

Name: Lake Forest Train Station
Address: 691 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The downtown train station connects Lake Forest to Chicago while keeping its small-town charm. The classic architecture fits perfectly into Market Square. It’s both functional and iconic.

Name: CROYA (Committee Representing Our Young Adults)
Address: 400 Hastings Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Croya is a teen-focused community center that brings energy and creativity to the town. It hosts events, programs, and social spaces for young residents. It feels lively and youth-driven.

Name: Penny's from Heaven
Address: 215 E Westminster, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Penny's from Heaven is a beloved children’s boutique in Market Square. It has a nostalgic, small-town feel and has been around for decades. It represents local retail charm, and personalized gifts for young children.

Name: The Lantern
Address: 555 N Sheridan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The Lantern is a restaurant and pub with dive bar-esque feels to it. It's a cozy spot for families to have a meal at, and a historic destination for Lake Forest College students to enjoy a beverage at night. This pub is known for it's town locals and Kareoke Tuesdays.

Name: Northcroft Park
Address: 1200 N Sheridan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Northcroft Park is located in the West side of Lake Forest, and known for its extensive fields. Popular amongst the AYSO league, many soccer games are held here on Saturday afternoons.

Name: Lake Forest Yacht Club
Address: 101 N Lake Shore Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The yacht club sits along the shoreline and adds a nautical character to the community. Sailboats and lake views give it a classic North Shore feel. It reflects Lake Forest’s connection to Lake Michigan.

Name: Lake Forest Academy
Address: 1500 W Kennedy Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Lake Forest Academy is a historic boarding school with a beautiful, expansive campus. The architecture and tree-lined paths feel classic and prestigious. It’s an important academic landmark in the area.

Name: First Presbyterian Church
Address: 321 W Deerpath Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: This church features beautiful traditional architecture and long-standing community involvement. It hosts events, services, and gatherings throughout the year. It feels like a foundational part of town life.

Name: Lake Forest Recreation Center
Address: 400 Hastings Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The recreation center provides fitness programs, classes, and events for residents of all ages. It’s energetic and community-focused. It reflects the active lifestyle of Lake Forest families.

Name: Everett Park
Address: 111 E Everett Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Everett Park is a smaller, quiet park tucked within residential streets. It’s peaceful and ideal for short walks or casual gatherings. It feels understated but welcoming.

Name: Lake Forest Montessori School
Address: 13700 W Laurel Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Lake Forest Montessori School serves early childhood to age 14 students in a close-knit setting. The school's purpose is to set children up for success in a small setting, with 1:1 learning opportunities.

Name: Townline Community Park
Address: 1 Townline Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Townline Park offers athletic fields and open space for local sports leagues. It’s especially active during spring and summer seasons. It feels energetic and family-centered.

Name: Lake Forest Symphony
Address: 400 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The Lake Forest Symphony brings professional-level music performances to the community. Concerts add a refined artistic presence to the town. It strengthens the local cultural scene.

Name: Lake Forest Festival & Fireworks (Deerpath Community Park)
Address: 400 Hastings Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: The annual July 4th celebration is a major tradition in Lake Forest. Families gather for live music, fireworks, and community festivities. It captures the small-town spirit of the area.

Name: Oaken Bistro + Bar
Address: 200 N Field Dr, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A refined and contemporary American bistro with flavorful dishes, craft cocktails, and a welcoming bar atmosphere. Great for brunch, dinner, or happy hour in a stylish yet relaxed setting.

Name: The English Room
Address: 255 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A classic fine-dining experience inside the historic Deer Path Inn, known for elegant service and refined dishes—perfect for special occasions.

Name: Francesca’s Intimo
Address: 293 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A cozy Italian trattoria with rustic pasta, wine, and comfort classics—one of the most popular Italian spots in town.

Name: Sophia Steak
Address: Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A steakhouse-style menu with classic cuts and a comfortable atmosphere—ideal for special nights out.

Name: The Gallery
Address: 202 E Wisconsin Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A refined dining spot blending contemporary cuisine with an art-inspired ambiance, known for creative dishes and excellent service.

Name: Egg Harbor Cafe
Address: 512 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A beloved breakfast and lunch café with hearty plates, crepes, and classic morning favorites.

Name: Kuro Bistro
Address: 950 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Contemporary Japanese cuisine and sushi, with everything from sashimi to creative rolls and grill menu items.

Name: White Hart Pub
Address: 255 E Illinois Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A casual English-style pub setting with pub classics and a friendly vibe for relaxed nights out.

Name: Sushi Kushi Toyo
Address: 825 S Waukegan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Classic Japanese sushi and favorites, often praised for fresh fish and attentive service.

Name: Chief’s Pub
Address: 502 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A local sports bar with comfort food, burgers, and a variety of beers—great for casual hangouts.

Name: Authentico Mexican Restaurant & Bar
Address: 770 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A lively Mexican spot with flavorful tacos and vibrant drinks—perfect for casual meals with friends.

Name: Ferentino’s Pizzeria East
Address: 824 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Classic Italian pizza with generous toppings and neighborhood favorites.

Name: Lou Malnati’s Pizzeria
Address: 840 S Waukegan Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Famous Chicago-style deep-dish and classic pies, great for takeout or casual dinners.

Name: Left Bank
Address: 659 N Bank Ln, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A casual lunch spot known for its sandwiches and hot dogs, right near Market Square.

Name: Donati’s Pizza
Address: 950 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Classic hand-tossed pizza and Italian favorites—a local comfort choice.

Name: Gerhard’s Elegant European Desserts
Address: 720 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: European-style desserts, pastries, and sweets—perfect for a post-dinner treat.

Name: Rosati’s Pizza
Address: 630 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Classic pizza chain offering thin crust and traditional Italian-American flavors.

Name: Dunkin’ Donuts
Address: 620 N Western Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: Classic coffee and donuts for quick breakfast or caffeine runs.

Name: Le Colonial
Address: 655 Forest Ave, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A popular French‑Vietnamese fusion restaurant known for elegant décor and a large, flavorful menu. Great for a nicer night out, and reservations help during busy times.

Name: Sweet’s
Address: 260 E Deerpath Rd, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A local institution serving chocolates, caramels, toffee, and rich ice cream. It’s an easy, classic stop after dinner downtown.

Name: Inovasi
Address: 28 E Center Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: An elegant yet relaxed bistro in downtown Lake Bluff known for a modern menu and stylish setting—great for lunch or dinner.

Name: The Otherdoor
Address: 30 E Center Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: A casual taqueria serving tacos, burritos, bowls, and nachos with bright décor and generous portions.

Name: Bluffington’s Café
Address: 113 E Scranton Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: A friendly café that’s great for breakfast, lunch, or coffee with a fun "local" vibe. I used to work here in high school! The owners are Horned Frog Alumni.

Name: Lake Bluff Brewing Co.
Address: 16 E Scranton Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: A small craft brewery and taproom featuring rotating beers and a pub menu, often with live music.

Name: Mavery Public House
Address: 20 E Scranton Ave, Lake Bluff, IL 60044
Description: An upscale tavern with American comfort food, plus wines and cocktails—popular for brunch, lunch, or dinner.

Name: Amidei Mercatino
Address: 235 South Gate, Market Square, Lake Forest, IL 60045
Description: A charming seasonal market in Market Square offering fresh fruits, vegetables, flowers, and specialty goods. It brings a European-style outdoor market feel to downtown Lake Forest and is a favorite warm-weather stop.

Description: Hometown is an all day cafe that specializes in coffee, juice, smoothies and food. It's a great place to grab a quick bite to eat -- you're guaranteed to run into someone you know!
